notes: Nominal geometry PASS means the API accepted catalog geometry, connection, wheel, structure, instruction and rule-based design gates. It does not demonstrate real-vehicle visual resemblance or a physical build.
No live research request is made. Source access statuses are recorded profile metadata, not fresh network checks.
Independent AutomotiveDesignScore is recorded only when exposed by the API. Missing independent or rejected-candidate score records remain null.
Screenshots are pending until actual browser captures are attached. Preview paths refer to saved UI sessions; packed JSON artifacts are not screenshots.

Actual browser screenshots are attached for all seven saved sessions. Direct review found shared rectangular cabins, flat roofs and similar front fascias; recognizable target-vehicle identity is not established. This visual limitation remains despite passing geometric heuristics.
Published model/session snapshots are losslessly gzip-compressed (.json.gz); fresh CLI runs write plain JSON. All 28 snapshots were decompressed and JSON-parsed after packaging.

visualReview.method: Direct inspection of all seven actual browser preview PNGs
visualReview.overall: These are rule-built LEGO concept cars. Shared rectangular cabins, flat roofs and similar front fascias dominate. Length and cabin proportions vary; target vehicle recognition is not demonstrated.
